app-templates.message:
feat(quiz): the learner chooses the number of questions at the start

## Intent

Let a learner answer only part of a quiz (#11) without any configuration by the creator. A shared link must still give everyone the same questions in the same order.

## Key changes

- Before the first question, a form asks how many questions to answer: from 1 to all, all by default.
- The seed and the chosen count are in the address (?seed=…&n=…). A link with them opens the same questions in the same order and skips the form; so do a link to a single question and a quiz of one question.
- Questions outside the run are removed with their solutions; progress and score count only the questions asked. Without JavaScript, the page still shows all questions.
- At the end, "Noch einmal" (en "Again") starts at once with a new seed and the same count. It is a link that looks like a button.
- The question bank needs no new setting. New texts in German and English, an end-to-end test for the form, README and runtime view updated.
